<div class="card-body">
'''K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">K-3PO (ケイ・スリーピオ)</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘を宣言し、また宣言されることができる。ホスかヤヴィン4では同じ位置にいる自分のドロイド1体ごとにK-3POの戦闘力は＋1となる。他の自分のドロイドが最低1体以上、同じ場所にいるなら、リーダーとして働く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-K-3PO-Kay-Threepio-PSA-74248143.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">旧型の通訳用ドロイド。ナーラ中佐のために働きながら軍事戦術を学んだ。エコー基地のドロイド置き場の管理を任されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' K-3PO (Kay-Threepio).

'''Card text:'''
May declare battle and be battled. On Hoth or Yavin 4, K-3PO is power +1 for each of your droids at the same location. If at least one other of your droids is at the same place, it functions as a leader.

'''Lore:'''
Old-model interpreter droid. It learned military tactics while working for Commander Narra. It is in charge of the droid storage at Echo Base.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 通訳用ドロイド.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
